itemized_rationale_corrections.before_description: Claim #223 described as 'Universal 365-day return window applicable to all categories'; Claim #224 described as 'Complete prohibition on returns/exchanges across all items'; both framed as 'diagnostic stress test'.
itemized_rationale_corrections.after_description: Claim #223 accurately described as Section 5 (p. 7) non-refundable item: 'Perishable goods such as freeze-dried meals past 14 days from delivery cannot be returned or refunded'. Claim #224 accurately described as Section 5 (p. 7) non-refundable item: 'Items returned more than 90 days after delivery cannot be returned or refunded'.
itemized_rationale_corrections.source_grounding: Northwind Refund Policy Handbook v4.2, Section 5 Non-Refundable Items, page 7.

itemized_rationale_corrections.before_description: Graduated dollar approval thresholds ($50 vs $200 vs $500 vs $1000).
itemized_rationale_corrections.after_description: Section 4.2 (p. 6) Manager approval thresholds: Up to $100: Tier 1 agent may approve; $100.01 - $500: Tier 2 agent or team lead approval required; Over $500: Customer Experience Manager approval required; Over $2,000: Finance Director approval and fraud review required.
itemized_rationale_corrections.source_grounding: Northwind Refund Policy Handbook v4.2, Section 4.2 Manager approval thresholds, page 6.

itemized_rationale_corrections.before_description: Attributed as an intra-section synonymy within Section 8.1 & 8.2 (pp. 7-8).
itemized_rationale_corrections.after_description: Cross-table comparison between Section 7 (p. 9, stage duration table: 'Debit card / bank transfer | 5-10 business days') and Section 8 (p. 10, payment method table notes: 'Debit card | Original card | Up to 10 business days'). Reconciled as typical duration range versus upper bound.
itemized_rationale_corrections.source_grounding: Northwind Refund Policy Handbook v4.2, Section 7 (p. 9) and Section 8 (p. 10).
fabricated_elements_removed: claim that Section 7 contains a separate 'up to 10 business days' row

itemized_rationale_corrections.before_description: Described as 'Real-time chat (24/7) vs telephone hotline hours (8am–8pm EST)'.
itemized_rationale_corrections.after_description: Section 19 (p. 21) table header 'Hours (Pacific Time)' defines channel-specific commitments: Email SLA is 'Response within 24 hours' and Mail is 'N/A'. (Handbook contact hours: Live chat Daily 7am-10pm PT; Phone US/Canada Mon-Fri 8am-8pm PT, Sat 9am-5pm PT; Refund status line 24/7 automated).
itemized_rationale_corrections.source_grounding: Northwind Refund Policy Handbook v4.2, Section 19 Contact Information and Escalation, page 21.
fabricated_elements_removed: EST timezone claim (all handbook hours are Pacific Time PT)

itemized_rationale_corrections.before_description: Generic list '(placed vs processing vs shipped vs delivered vs pre-order vs backorder)'.
itemized_rationale_corrections.after_description: Section 11 (p. 13) Order Cancellations table rows for Shipped, Delivered, Pre-order, and Backordered order stages governing cancellation eligibility ('No' vs 'Yes, until 7 days before release' vs 'Yes, anytime') and refund routing ('Refuse delivery or return' vs 'Standard return policy' vs 'Full refund').
itemized_rationale_corrections.source_grounding: Northwind Refund Policy Handbook v4.2, Section 11 Order Cancellations, page 13.

itemized_rationale_corrections.before_description: Generic ladder summary '(Notice -> Restricted -> Suspended -> Permanent account closure)'.
itemized_rationale_corrections.after_description: Section 17.1 (p. 19) Consequences table rows for Notice (30-40% return rate; email reminder), Restricted (>40% return rate or 1 abuse case; store credit only, manager approval), Suspended (multiple abuse cases; 12-month account suspension), and Permanent (fraud or counterfeit return; account closure, law enforcement referral).
itemized_rationale_corrections.source_grounding: Northwind Refund Policy Handbook v4.2, Section 17.1 Consequences, page 19.
